memory_candidates.content: When mechanizing from an OCR'd PDF, a dropped displayed equation is often missing from the pdftotext text layer as well as from the chunked corpus -- both derive from the same text layer. Only the page raster carries it. Read the PDF with the pages parameter (image extraction) rather than assuming a re-extraction will recover it.

A formalized 'classical model of a frame theory' clause must relativize its quantifiers to the structure's domain. Transcribing Simpson-style 'H ⊨_CL χ' as a type-wide '∀ x, R x x' silently strengthens it; combined with a Graph invariant confining edges to nodes, it forces X = univ and can render the whole prime-context type UNINHABITED. Check inhabitation of a target structure type BEFORE attempting a Zorn construction that produces it -- an IsEmpty proof is far cheaper than a failed 300-line maximization.

A uniform published proof can degenerate into vacuity on a special case while still being sound: Simpson's Lemma 5.3.1 discharges 'H is a classical model of 𝒯' via a reductio plus a requirement-3 citation, but for quantifier-free axioms (empty witness vector) BOTH steps are vacuous and the goal is delivered instead by the maximality step used directly. Before concluding a source's argument is broken on your special case, check whether the general machinery simply does not specialize -- the load-bearing step may be present but used for a different purpose.
